final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT mt.Name AS name, AVG(t.Bytes * 1.0 / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_ratio FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY mt.Name), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall FROM s1) SELECT s1.name, s1.avg_ratio, s1.avg_ratio - s2.overall FROM s1, s2 WHERE s2.overall IS NOT NULL AND s1.avg_ratio > s2.overall
